evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth (2.97 → 3.09 → 3.13 → 3.23 Torr) while Ar setpoint and flow are constant at 100 sccm
MFC reading steady at ~99.8 sccm, so the pressure rise is not driven by commanded flow
Temperature holds setpoint 750 °C with normal heater power ~44%, so no thermal anomaly
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (sensor not installed) to distinguish air ingress via a seal leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; alternatively a pump-down/flow-step test: briefly cut Ar to zero — pressure that keeps rising indicates a leak, pressure that falls slowly with high conductance loss indicates blockage.
